title: Less Clicking. More Transcribing.
summary: Transcription is a game of momentum. Whether you're reviewing interviews, customer calls, research recordings, media content, or AI training data, productivity often comes down to how long you can stay focused on the audio itself. Every interruption—reaching for a mouse, navigating menus, or switching between tools—breaks concentration and slows the review process. That's why we've introduced new workflow enhancements designed to help transcriptionists and reviewers spend less time interacting with the interface and more time focusing on the content.
